traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.text: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
The chort devil's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The chort devil can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

At will: blur, magic circle, teleportation

3/day: scorching ray (5 rays)

1/day each: dispel magic, dominate person, flame strike, haste

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The chort devil makes three melee attacks with its flaming ranseur, or three melee attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Charisma damage.

actions.name: Flaming Ranseur
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Devilish Weapons
actions.text: Any weapons wielded by a chort devil do 10 (3d6) fire damage in addition to their normal weapon damage.
